CREATE TABLE "public"."parkingMap" (
  "freeSpots" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "totalSpots" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."parkingSpot" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "parkingMapId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment" (
  "amountCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentInfoId" text,
  "receipt" json,
  "reservationId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."paymentInfo" (
  "details" json NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "preferredMethod" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reservation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "parkingSpotId" text NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "vehicleId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscription" (
  "amountCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transaction" (
  "amountCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentId" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."vehicle" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "licensePlate" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
